'''Alejandro Aceves''' is an American [[mathematician]]. He is a professor in the department of [[mathematics]] at [[Southern Methodist University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://people.smu.edu/aaceves/prof-alejandro-aceves/|title=Alejandro Aceves|work=[[Southern Methodist University]]|access-date=August 15, 2026}}</ref>

In 2025, Aceves was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=aceves&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=August 5, 2026}}</ref>
